title: Procon-RJ launches guide on risks of online betting
seoTitle: Procon-RJ guide warns about online bets
subtitle: Guide advises consumers to protect money, health and family
excerpt: Procon-RJ releases the guide 'Online Betting: Bets and Gambling – Protect Your Money, Health, and Family', offering advice on betting risks.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Monday (the 10th), the Rio de Janeiro Consumer Protection and Defense Program (Procon-RJ) launched a guide titled Online Betting: Bets and Gambling – Protect Your Money, Your Health, and Your Family. The material provides guidance aimed at those who engage in virtual betting, highlighting the main risks associated with this practice.

Guide’s Objective

The guide’s primary focus is to alert consumers about the financial and health impacts that can arise from participating in online gambling. By combining information on financial security, physical well‑being, and family protection, the publication seeks to offer a comprehensive overview for anyone who decides to bet online.

Key Risks Highlighted

Among the risks described, the guide emphasizes the possibility of significant financial losses, the development of compulsive behaviors, and exposure to virtual environments that can compromise mental health. It also addresses the side effects on family dynamics, such as tension and conflict stemming from unexpected spending.

  • Financial risk: betting can generate expenses that exceed personal budgets.
  • Health risk: excessive use of betting platforms may lead to stress, anxiety, and sleep disturbances.
  • Family risk: involvement in gambling can cause misunderstandings and damage family relationships.

Practical Guidance

The guide presents recommendations for consumers to adopt preventive measures, such as setting spending limits, researching the reliability of betting sites, and recognizing signs of problematic behavior. It also suggests seeking specialized support when there are indications of compulsive gambling.

By making the material available, Procon-RJ reinforces its role as a consumer‑defense agent, offering educational resources that help mitigate the dangers associated with online betting. The initiative aims to contribute to a safer and more conscious consumption environment.

With information from Agência Brasil.
